name: hermes-agent
description: Nous Research Hermes Agent (autonomous, persistent-memory AI agent) on oci-apps. Messaging gateway (Telegram live, Mattermost scaffolded) backed by claude-superset-api (subscription CLI, no metered key). WG-internal, never public.

agent._comment: The shared checkout (docker volume cloud-git-gh) mounts at ONE canonical path in EVERY agent container — /home/appuser/git — declared once in _shared/engine.nix and published to the container as AGENT_GIT_TREE. The per-container git_tree_mount field is GONE and setting it is now a build error. It used to claim to be 'this container's own $HOME/git' with nothing checking, and the three agent containers drifted to three different answers; hermes ended up with the tree at /opt/data/git while its running HOME was /root, so `ls $HOME/git` found nothing and the agent reported the repositories as missing. Read-write: an agent that can read the code but not commit it cannot do the job it exists for.
agent._comment_working_directory: Hermes' main process is an s6-supervised idle holder; the real work arrives as `docker exec`, which starts at the image WorkingDir (/opt/hermes) — outside the checkout. The agent then sees zero repositories and answers as if the code did not exist. Starting it in the tree is the point of mounting the tree.

docker._agent_toolbelt_doc: ticket #509: agent_toolbelt=true replaces the hand-written runtime_packages/runtime_extra_run pair that used to live here. _shared/engine.nix now derives both from the single fleet-wide declaration in _shared/agent-toolbelt.json (the same one my-ai_claude-api and my-ai-api splice into their own Dockerfiles), so this container's tool list cannot drift from theirs.
